Cairn Thane

Huge undead, lawful evil

Armor Class 16 (rotted mail and grave-cloth)

Hit Points 161 (14d12 + 70)

Speed 30 ft.

STR	DEX	CON	INT	WIS	CHA
23 (+6)	8 (−1)	20 (+5)	9 (−1)	14 (+2)	16 (+3)

Saving Throws Con +9, Wis +6

Skills Intimidation +7, Perception +6

Damage Resistances cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

Damage Immunities poison

Condition Immunities charmed, exhaustion, poisoned

Senses darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 16

Languages Giant, understands Common but can't speak

Challenge 11 (7,200 XP)        Proficiency Bonus +4

Unending Watch. The Cairn Thane doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Weight of Ages. The crushing presence of a long-dead chieftain fills the cairn. A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the Cairn Thane must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or suffer the following until the start of its next turn:

Its speed is reduced by 10 feet.
It has disadvantage on the next weapon attack roll it makes.
Actions

Multiattack. The Cairn Thane makes two Grave Maul attacks.

Grave Maul. Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the Cairn Thane's next turn.

Hurl Cairnstone (Recharge 5–6). Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

Barrow's Grip (Recharge 6). The Cairn Thane targets one Large or smaller creature it can see within 60 feet of it. Grasping roots of black stone burst up around the target, which must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and is restrained until the end of its next turn.

Reactions

Judge the Bold. When a creature within the Cairn Thane's reach misses it with a melee attack, the Cairn Thane can immediately make one Grave Maul attack against that creature.

Legendary Actions

The Cairn Thane can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Cairn Thane regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

Thane's Stride. The Cairn Thane moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

Grave Maul (Costs 2 Actions). The Cairn Thane makes one Grave Maul attack.

Lair Actions

When fighting within its cairn, the Cairn Thane can draw on the old oaths sworn there. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the Cairn Thane takes one lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

Oathbound Echo. Old voices thunder through the cairn. Each enemy within 30 feet of the Cairn Thane must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of it until the end of its next turn.

Thane's Summons. The Cairn Thane chooses one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or use its movement on its next turn to move toward the Cairn Thane.

Collapsing Lintel. The Cairn Thane shakes the old stones, and a lintel crashes down. It chooses a point it can see within 60 feet; each creature within 10 feet of that point must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (3d10) bludgeoning damage.

Regional Effects

The resting place of a Cairn Thane is steeped in old oath-magic, which creates one or more of the following effects:

Carved spirals on standing stones faintly glow at dusk.
Footsteps echo as though a second walker follows a pace behind.
Birds will not nest within sight of the cairn.
Creatures that sleep within 1 mile of the cairn dream of a long hall and a silent feast.

If the Cairn Thane is destroyed, these effects fade over the course of 1d10 days.
